_meanings:
A particle implying
 (1) assent, admission or acceptance. (In this sense it is usually used
 with the roots {#kf, BU#}, or {#as#} and it has the force of a {#gati#}
 or preposition; {#urarIkftya#} not {#urarIkftvA#}. Other forms of the
 word are {#urI, ururI, UrI#} and {#UrurI#}.); (2) Extension.
